verdict.rationale: Clerky publishes Partner API developer docs at developers.clerky.com. These include a lifecycle walkthrough that links endpoint reference pages (POST /v1/document_sets, GET /v1/document_sets/{id}/forms) and an llms.txt index, so a reference exists. Nothing shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and authentication is still 'coming soon', so live calls cannot yet be made. missing for 10: interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, published OpenAPI spec, available auth credentials/sandbox for executing requests, independent corroboration.
